fusions.name: Swallow Whole
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health. Bites for 16 damage and swallows every affliction on it, adding 1.6 times their remaining damage. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Feeding Frenzy
fusions.desc: Bites at everything around you, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, and you heal for 15% of the damage dealt. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Shared Catch
fusions.desc: Restores 15 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and 1% more for each 1% of cast speed you have.

fusions.name: Chum Slick
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, 20% of the damage you deal heals you for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
